[LEXP.5.11.2] **`great_circle` is this composition, and no other.** Every
operation is rounded once, and no two are fused ([LDET.3.6.1]). $\operatorname{rad}$
is `radians` ([LEXP.3.6.1]); $\sin$, $\cos$, $\operatorname{atan2}$ and
$\sqrt{\cdot}$ are the correctly rounded functions of [LEXP.3.9] and [LEXP.3.2];
$\hat R$ is [LEXP.5.11.1]'s radius:

$$\phi_1 = \operatorname{rad}(\mathit{lat}_1), \quad \phi_2 = \operatorname{rad}(\mathit{lat}_2), \quad \Delta\phi = \operatorname{rad}(\mathit{lat}_2 - \mathit{lat}_1), \quad \Delta\lambda = \operatorname{rad}(\mathit{lon}_2 - \mathit{lon}_1)$$

$$s = \sin(\Delta\phi / 2), \qquad t = \sin(\Delta\lambda / 2)$$

$$a = s \times s + (\cos\phi_1 \times \cos\phi_2) \times (t \times t)$$

$$a' = \min(\max(a, 0), 1)$$

$$d = \hat R \times \bigl(2 \times \operatorname{atan2}(\sqrt{a'}, \sqrt{1 - a'})\bigr)$$

The terms are associated as written. The clamp to $[0, 1]$ chooses $a$, $0$ or
$1$ and rounds nothing.
